subject: Stage A: network outage + outlet scorch — contingency & schedule swap
related_account: Northstar Conference Center / Cygnus AI Sponsorship
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Jane Davis <jane.davis@northstarvenue.com>, Mike AV <mike.av@proav.co>, Emily S. <emily.sponsor@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stage A: intermittent network + outlet trip — immediate contingency?

Team / venue / AV,

Quick heads up from first setup pass: Stage A uplink is unstable (observed packet loss when testing stream box) and Exhibitor Row 3A reported an outlet that popped and gave a faint burnt smell near the floor. No flames, but the strip is tripped. We need a rapid plan so morning sessions are not impacted.

Immediate asks:
- Jane: can you confirm venue electrician availability now and whether subpanel access is OK?
- Mike (AV): can you confirm whether stage streaming has an LTE failover box on standby and ETA to deploy?
- Ben/Tessa: please stage a spare PDU and extension cord kit by 3A in case we need to swap.
- Dev: can you bring the two LTE hotspots and NAT box we discussed?

I attached the Level 1 floorplan (floorplan_level1.pdf) — 3A marked. We need a single consolidated plan in the next 20 minutes.

Marissa
Events Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Mike AV <mike.av@proav.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Jane Davis <jane.davis@northstarvenue.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage A: intermittent network + outlet trip — immediate contingency?

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 08:05 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick heads up from first setup pass...

Seeing the same packet loss on uplink 10.8.3.2 from our monitor. We have a battery-backed LTE router on the truck (model: Peplink BR1 Pro). Can deploy to stage rack in ~20 minutes if we get green light and subpanel access.

Proposal (short-term):
- Run a short dedicated cat6 from stage rack to DMZ switch (bypass venue uplink)
- Power the stream box from our UPS and place Peplink as upstream so stream uses LTE if uplink drops
- If outlet needs replacement, we can keep stream on UPS while venue replaces the outlet.

Jane: we will need a staff escort for the run to avoid public areas.

-Mike
ProAV Services (on-site)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Mike AV <mike.av@proav.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage A: intermittent network + outlet trip — immediate contingency?

I can be on-site with two LTE hotspots, preconfigured NAT and a small router. Quick configuration notes for whoever runs the box:
- Hotspots: SSID redwood-failover-1 / redwood-failover-2, WPA2, admin pass on lastpass entry (Event Hotspots)
- Router IP: 10.10.10.1 (connect via ethernet), web UI on 10.10.10.1:8080
- Quick route switch command (if you have CLI): sudo ip route replace default via 10.10.10.254 dev eth1

If AV can do the physical run, I will bring the gear and stand up the NAT so demo machines can be NATted through the hotspot. Also: if the PDU needs a hard reset, unplug the PDU breaker for 10s then re-power — Ben, please only do this if you confirm the linked racks are not powering other critical gear.

I'm 10 mins out.
-Dev
From: Dr. Samuel Green <sam.green@gmail.com>
To: Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@aiforum.org>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage A: intermittent network + outlet trip — immediate contingency?

Hi all — sorry, stuck behind a stalled truck on I-5. I'm showing ~25 minutes out. If it's helpful I can either: 1) be moved to the 09:30 slot and do the full talk then, or 2) swap with Sarah (cc) who is here and can go on at 09:00. I'm happy with whichever keeps the program moving.

Apologies for the disruption — Sam
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Mike AV <mike.av@proav.co>, Jane Davis <jane.davis@northstarvenue.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Emily S. <emily.sponsor@cygnus.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@aiforum.org>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage A: intermittent network + outlet trip — contingency & schedule swap

Thanks all — clear plan below. I'm assigning owners and deadlines so we can move quickly.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Mike (AV): run dedicated cat6 to DMZ and place Peplink in front of stream box (ETA 08:50). Confirm once live.
- Dev (Redwood): bring LTE hotspots & NAT; stand up failover network and advise on routing (arrived 08:28).
- Jane (Venue): please assign electrician to look at outlet 3A and confirm whether simple outlet replacement is OK or if we need to pull a new circuit (ETA 09:15).
- Ben: stage spare PDU and extension kit at 3A and do a PDU reset only if instructed by Mike/Dev (ETA 08:40).
- Marissa/Tessa: update the front-of-house schedule and swap speakers — Sarah to go at 09:00, Sam to follow at 09:30 (notify attendees).

Attachments: workorder_456.pdf (venue work order for outlet replacement).

Please reply once your item is done OR if anything changes. If web streaming still shows packet loss after the Peplink is in place, we will cut to the failover stream hosted from the mobile box and notify watchers that we're on backup.

Grace
VP, Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Events Team <events@redwood.com>, Jane Davis <jane.davis@northstarvenue.com>, Mike AV <mike.av@proav.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Emily S. <emily.sponsor@cygnus.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Stage A: network outage + outlet scorch — contingency & schedule swap (RESOLVED)

Status update — all items cleared:
- AV wired bypass live at 09:50; stream moved to Peplink UPS and has been stable since then.
- Hotspots (redwood-failover-1/2) active and demo machines NATted via Dev's router; no further packet loss observed on demos.
- Speaker swap executed: Sarah Lin presented at 09:05; Sam spoke at 09:35 (network held during both sessions).
- Venue electrician replaced the outlet and tested circuits; minor scorch cleaned and outlet replaced at ~10:40. Ben confirmed the area is safe.

Attached: site_photos_1100.jpg (photo of replaced outlet & stage rack).

Thanks to everyone for quick responses — closing the incident.

Marissa
Events Manager
Redwood Inference
